{{Top|leg}}
'''Red-Eye''' was a short range, tactical [[Targeting laser/Legends|spot luma]] for use on [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]], and when installed, worked by projecting a dot of light at the target. It found wide use by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].
